jobs.title: General Manager, Greater China Region
jobs.description:
About Us:

AppsFlyer helps the world's leading brands understand what their marketing is actually doing.
Our measurement, analytics and audience platform processes billions of events a day for customers who need to separate what works from what only looks like it works.
We were built by people who came out of the industry we serve, and staying close to that problem is still how we operate.

Measurement is being rebuilt right now. Platform privacy changes, the shift from deterministic attribution toward incrementality and modelling, and AI moving from a product feature to the way marketing decisions actually get made.
All of it lands on our roadmap and on our customers' desks at the same time. Greater China is where it plays out fastest.

About the role:

GCR is AppsFlyer's largest market in Asia and one of the most competitive measurement markets in the world. The General Manager owns the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, people, product relevance and market position. You'll set the strategy, build and hold the leadership team, and be the face of AppsFlyer to customers, platforms, partners, media and regulators in China.

This is a defend-and-grow mandate. The business is established and the brand is known. Growth from here comes from deepening our largest accounts, winning the outbound motion as Chinese apps and brands scale overseas, and making sure the platform solves the measurement problems Chinese marketers actually have.

What you'll do:

- Own the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, and budget against plan

- Set multi-year regional strategy: which verticals and segments to prioritise, resource, or walk away from

- Build and lead a regional leadership team spanning revenue, customer engagement, partnerships and marketing, and grow the bench beneath them

- Drive business transformation, leading the team into an AI-native organisation

- Hold executive and board-level relationships at our largest customers, and get personally involved in the deals that set the region's trajectory

- Negotiate strategic partnerships with major platforms, agencies and channel partners in China

- Represent AppsFlyer publicly in China: press, industry forums, and conferences

- Own the product agenda for GCR: identify where the platform falls short for local customers, build the case, and drive it through global product and engineering

- Ensure full regulatory, data and labour compliance in partnership with Legal, Finance and People

What you'll bring:

- 15+ years of commercial leadership, including at least 5 years owning a country or regional P&L

- Accountability for a sizable recurring-revenue business and a multi-function organisation of 100+ people.

- Track record of growing and managing a $100M+ business, across several segments.

- Enterprise SaaS, adtech, martech or platform experience

- Experience owning both sides of the revenue equation: acquisition and retention

- Experience leading an organization through structural change: merging functions, redrawing reporting lines, or integrating teams

- A track record of hiring, developing and retaining top talent

- Deep working knowledge of the China market: regulatory and data environment, business culture, and how deals actually close

- Established relationships across the China mobile ecosystem: platforms, agencies, or large app publishers

- Native Mandarin and business-fluent English

Bonus points:

- Experience with the outbound motion: Chinese apps, games or brands scaling into overseas markets

- Direct negotiation history with major Chinese platforms

- Background in gaming, e-commerce, fintech or other high-velocity consumer app verticals

- Experience carrying a business from growth stage into a mature defend-and-grow phase

- Technical or product background

- MBA or equivalent advanced degree

As a global company operating across five continents, we reflect the human mosaic of the diverse and multicultural world in which we live. We ensure equal opportunities for all of our employees and promote the recruitment of diverse talent to our global teams without consideration of race, gender, culture, or sexual orientation. We value and encourage curiosity, diversity, and innovation from all our employees, customers, and partners

jobs.title: Senior PR&D Program Manager
jobs.description:
As part of our continued growth, we are looking for a talented Program Manager with a strong background in building, growing and leading program management for SaaS products to join our team.

Program managers at AppsFlyer bring clarity and visibility to the entire organization by applying effective processes, defining best practices, continuously identifying gaps and pushing to improve them.

This role goes beyond a single transformation; it is about orchestrating complex, cross-functional initiatives that shape the future of AppsFlyer. You will lead large-scale execution efforts, scale collaboration across R&D, Product, and GTM, and drive alignment on high-impact programs. You will also mentor and coach R&D and Product leaders, ensuring they adopt best-in-class program management practices to scale our efforts successfully.

This is a strategic, high-visibility role at the heart of AppsFlyer's future.

What you'll do

- Be a part of the unit leadership and facilitate PR&D strategy and methodologies definition

- Lead (hands on) complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your program management expertise

- Be part of AppsFlyer program management guild aim to shape and align our software delivery processes

- Define and implement the unit metrics and KPIs

- Coach our teams for excellence using agile methodologies and make sure they know that they are on track

- Facilitate the unit quarterly planning and QPR processes

- Identify opportunities to apply AI/automation to program management workflows (planning, reporting, risk tracking, retrospectives) and drive their adoption across the unit

What you have

- Exceptional ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment, with the strategic thinking to lead change across a complex organization

- 5+ years of program management experience within an engineering and product environment on SaaS products

- Experience in leading large-scale projects and working through a complete product cycle (from initial design through post-release sustainment) in large scale organizations (~500 R&D and Product)

- Deep understanding of Agile, program management methodologies, JIRA, and the Atlassian stack

- Mentoring and coaching skills

- Can embrace change, effectively handle ambiguity and help others understand and cope with changes

- Working familiarity with AI tools relevant to program management (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) and a track record of using them to speed up planning, reporting, or documentation

- Basic understanding of data infrastructure and pipelines (how data flows from product/engineering systems into dashboards and BI tools) - enough to spot where automation or better data can remove manual work

- A hands-on, figure-it-out-yourself mentality - comfortable prototyping a solution, testing a tool, or building a lightweight dashboard rather than just spec'ing it for someone else

Bonus points

- Experience introducing or scaling AI-powered tools/workflows within an R&D Product org

- JIRA admin experience

- Software engineering experience

- Recommended by an AppsFlyer employee

We ensure equal opportunities for all of our employees and promote the recruitment of diverse talents to our global teams without consideration of race, gender, culture, or sexual orientation. We value and encourage curiosity, diversity, and innovation from all our employees, customers, and partners.

jobs.title: Commercial Partnerships Manager (Bangkok Based)
jobs.description:
Here at AppsFlyer, it’s all about the people; each and every one of us has our own specialty, a unique flavor that we bring to the table. We are all driven individuals whose interests are just as diverse as we are. You could say we’re #PeopleObsessed. When we say obsession, we mean we will do everything to make you feel those AF vibes; whether it’s company breakfasts, happy hours, and parties, our connection to each other is always a core focus.

Few markets in the world demand the level of commercial sophistication, cultural fluency, and strategic agility that Korea and Japan do. As the Commercial Partnership Manager, you will manage AppsFlyer's partner growth across Korea and Japan, shaping an ecosystem at the heart of our Asia-Pacific ambitions.

This is a role is based in Bangkok, Thailand for someone who thrives on ownership. You will manage relationships from first contact to signed agreements, co-build go-to-market plans with key partners, and be the person who makes things happen in one of our most important global markets.

What you'll do:

Commercial Growth and Revenue

- Drive partner-led revenue by identifying, developing, and closing high-value commercial partnerships across the Korea and Japan mobile ecosystem

- Own partner-driven pipeline, including new partner acquisition, activation, and retention initiatives

- Develop and execute joint business plans with key partners to unlock new revenue streams

-  Negotiate and close commercial agreements and partnership contracts

- Execute go-to-market strategies for new products and market opportunities within Korea and Japan

Partnership Development and Ecosystem Expansion

- Build and grow relationships with strategic partners — including DSPs, media networks, agencies, OEMs, and technology platforms active in Korea and Japan.

- Identify emerging trends, distribution channels, and niche partnership opportunities specific to the Korea and Japan markets

- Represent AppsFlyer at industry events, conferences, and partner summits across the region

- Drive co-marketing initiatives, cross-promotions, and strategic alliances

Cross-functional Execution and Alignment

- Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal teams to align partnership strategies with broader business priorities

- Lead partner integration discussions and support product adoption across the Korea and Japan ecosystem

- Provide ongoing partner enablement, training, and performance reviews

- Maintain clear and consistent reporting on pipeline, partner health, and growth metrics

Market Intelligence and Continuous Improvement

- Translate Korea and Japan market dynamics, partner feedback, and competitive intelligence into actionable internal recommendations

- Leverage AI-powered analytics and data-driven insights to prioritize partnership efforts, spot emerging opportunities, and continuously optimize commercial outcomes across the Korea and Japan ecosystem.

- Ensure compliance with local regulations and maintain strong commercial discipline.

Who you are:

- 5+ years in partnerships, business development, or commercial sales within mobile AdTech, SaaS, or digital advertising

- Proven revenue growth through partnerships and complex deal execution

- Deep knowledge of the Japan & Korea mobile ecosystem - platforms, Ad tech players, and local business culture

- Korean and Japanese fluency (written and spoken) and strong English proficiency - both required

- Solid grasp of Korea and Japan markets - App Ecosystem, SDK data practices

- Daily AI user - you embed AI into research, prioritization, and decision-making as a matter of habit, not curiosity

- Entrepreneurial, self-directed, and able to present complex ideas simply to any audience

Preferred Requirements

- Direct experience managing MMP, DSP, Ad Network, or agency partnerships in the Korea and Japan market

- Experience with SaaS product partnerships or mobile analytics platforms

- Strong existing network within the Korea and Japan mobile advertising or marketing technology ecosystem

- Being introduced by an AppsFlyer team member

Requisition ID: 2862

AppsFlyer is a global company with 20 offices worldwide. Through mental health programs like Be Well, the Global Employee Exchange Program, and fitness programs, we empower our people to thrive physically, mentally, and professionally.

Here, titles don’t define us—ideas do. You’ll thrive in a culture where everyone’s input shapes the future.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, GCR
jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Manager, GCR

At AppsFlyer, we believe great marketing doesn't just build brands—it drives business growth. As the Growth Marketing Manager for GCR, you will play an important role in shaping how we connect with customers, create meaningful touchpoints across their lifecycle, and transform marketing influence into real pipeline impact.

In this role, you will lead the evaluation and analysis of integrated, multi-channel marketing strategies/plans across events, content, ABM, digital and owned media. You will analyze performance end-to-end to uncover insights that drive and accelerate new logo acquisition, upsell, and renewal to assist the marketing leadership to define and optimize the marketing strategies and plans in the GCR market.

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between marketing activity and business results, thrives in cross-functional environments, and brings strong ownership to everything they do. This person should be able to understand and facilitate the diversified marketing activities that generate relevant, sales-ready leads that can be nurtured into qualified opportunities, while also driving upsell and renewal acceleration through various marketing initiatives.

What you’ll do

- Partner closely with Sales to evaluate the full inbound revenue funnel, gaining a clear understanding of how marketing activities influence lead quality, sales velocity, pipeline acceleration, and overall revenue performance.

- Support Marketing leadership in designing scalable inbound strategies that consistently generate qualified leads and accelerate pipeline creation in the GCR market. Lead regional pipeline analysis, extract actionable insights, and drive ongoing optimization across all marketing efforts.

- Build and manage goal-setting and performance measurement across all inbound marketing channels—including ABM programs, content initiatives, events, and digital touchpoints—covering planning, data tracking, analysis, and reporting.

- Lead the evaluation, implementation, and adoption of marketing automation tools for the GCR market, and as the main POC for GCR to work closely with Global Marketing Operations to streamline lead processes and optimize nurturing activities.

- Direct paid media efforts across GCR (SEM, social ads, vertical ads, and other paid online channels including lead gen, inbound, ABM, and content syndication), work closely with global growth marketing team and in partnership with paid media agencies—owning ROI management, test-and-learn strategies, and in-market test plans, and working with Sales to connect ad performance to pipeline and revenue impact.

- Own GCR digital assets—including the regional website and LPs—managing day-to-day operations and maintenance, and serving as the interface between the GCR Marketing team and HQ counterparts.

- Manage agencies and vendor partners to successfully execute campaigns and strategic initiatives, including creating content and deliverables (landing pages, ad copies, videos) with design and copywriting teams.

- Report regularly to management and regional stakeholders on paid and overall marketing performance.

What you have

-  3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing, growth marketing, or revenue/pipeline-focused roles. Paid media and field marketing experience is a strong plus.

- Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution ability; comfortable designing cross-channel plans.

- Excellent analytical skills—able to interpret data, extract insights, and influence decisions with clear storytelling.

- A growth mindset with strong cross-team collaboration abilities and empathy.

- Exceptional communication skills and an ability to build trust with senior stakeholders.

- Move fast, highly structured, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable operating in lean and dynamic settings.

- Familiarity with mobile apps, SaaS, and marketing technologies. Proficient in leveraging AI tools to improve work efficiency.

- Strong data literacy; Excel proficiency preferred.

- Experience working with agencies, freelancers, and external vendors.

Bonus Points:

- Introduced by an AppsFlyer team member

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Product Partnerships Manager in Israel to lead AppsFlyer’s efforts in improving measurement integrity, partner signal quality, and exploring joint technological offerings with strategic partners.

You will interact with top-tier partners (ad networks and martech platforms) and work cross-functionally with internal Partnerships, Product, R&D, and marketing teams to advance mutual projects and present the partner angle of every product-related initiative.

The Product Partnerships team operates at the intersection of product, partners, and ecosystem strategy.

Our mission is to extend AppsFlyer’s measurement authority across the ad ecosystem by improving partners’ data integrity and signal quality, and by broadening and deepening partners’ integrations with AppsFlyer features.

The Product Partnerships Manager role is perfect for someone with a technical/product orientation, and a strong knowledge of the ad tech ecosystem, who loves solving problems and creating win-win situations with partners.

What you'll do:

- Own strategic product collaboration with key platforms across the advertising and marketing ecosystem (e.g. ad networks, DSPs, analytics and engagement platforms)

- Unlock obstacles to partner integrations and capabilities by working closely with Product and R&D teams to define, build, and improve scalable solutions

- Ensure high-quality data flows and measurement integrity , acting as a subject matter expert towards partners on attribution, data accuracy, and signal quality

- Identify and execute opportunities to enhance partner value , including improving performance, expanding use cases, and increasing partner adoption

- Support revenue growth through partnerships by enabling deals, removing technical blockers, and aligning partner capabilities with customer needs

- Act as the voice of partners internally , influencing product roadmap, prioritization, and go-to-market strategies

- Lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success to deliver impactful partner solutions

- Monitor ecosystem trends and partner developments , identifying risks, opportunities, and competitive dynamics

- Drive operational excellence and scalability , improving processes and leveraging AI and automation where possible

- Operate self-sufficently to pull and analyze data to understand impact of product changes on partners and identify potential issues

- Collaborate with marketing on communication to partners about product updates and changes

What you have:

- 5+ years of experience in ad tech, in a role that interfaces primarily with both internal and external product personas.

- Strong understanding of integrations, APIs, and data flows

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to communicate and present idiomatically in English

- Background in data, analytics, integration engineering or technical product roles

Bonus Points:

- Proven experience of implementing AI automated workflows

- Experience at an MMP, DSP or ad network

- Strong knowledge of mobile and web attribution

-  Advanced SQL skills

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Partnership Development Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
Role Objective

As a Senior Partner Development Manager - Chinese Speaker at AppsFlyer, you will act as the strategic liaison between AppsFlyer and our most influential media and technology partners, such as Meta, Google, TikTok and more.  You will develop and execute partnership strategies that drive mutual business growth and innovation.  This role requires a highly independent operator with exceptional relationship and communication skills, cross-cultural fluency, and the ability to align global stakeholders around shared goals.

Key Responsibilities

- Build deep understanding of each partner's business, challenges and opportunities.

- Map and manage key stakeholders across partner organizations, navigating towards shared goals

- Develop and execute partnership strategies with our top partners.

- Manage multiple partner relationships with strong planning and prioritization discipline

- Represent AppsFlyer at industry events and lead GTM initiatives including co-marketing, product adoption and thought leadership

- Identify and actualize collaboration opportunities including joint marketing campaigns, shared research, go-to-market programs

- Ensure strong internal alignment and communication to ensure regional  buy-in for executing partnership initiatives.

Required Skills and Attributes:

- Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships across all stakeholder levels - from operational to leadership - within partner organizations across SEAPAC & GCR markets

- Multilingual communication: must operate fluently in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) - written and spoken - across partner meetings, executive business reviews and external-facing content

- Eloquent presentation skill; must be well versed in presenting both business and technical topics to partner stakeholders and in public forums.

- Business Acumen: Strategic thinker who understand the APAC competitive landscape and can navigate independently

- Problem-Solving: Proactively identify and resolve partnership friction before it escalates

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- Fluent in Chinese (Mandarin) & English.

- 5+ years in Partner Management, Strategic Alliances, or Business Development within the tech industry.

- Proven experience managing strategic partnerships across APAC markets, with a strong understanding of the region's diverse business landscapes, culture, and stakeholder dynamics.

- Full professional fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken) is a strict requirement for this role

- Product knowledge of mobile advertising and MMPs is a strong advantage

- Experience working with global partners, and internal global and cross-regional teams

Bonus Points :

- Referred by AppsFlyer employee

- Product knowledge of mobile advertising or MMP

- Additional Asian fluency (Japanese, Korean, Bahasa, etc)

Position Number: 2,832

You'll play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of AppsFlyer's partner ecosystem across one of the world's most dynamic regions.  Your work will directly influence product adoption, market expansion, and long-term growth - operating at the intersection of innovation, partnership, and business strategy.

jobs.title: Product Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
Lead Partner Development Manager, Strategic Partnerships

AppsFlyer’s Partner Development team builds and scales relationships with our top strategic partners, ensuring integrations are technically sound, commercially valuable, and widely adopted by advertisers. We’re looking for a Lead Partner Development Manager to own our relationships with companies like Google, Apple, Amazon, and more, sitting at the intersection of Partners, Product, R&D, Data, and GTM.

You’ll identify and create results that work for our mutual customers, helping reinforce AppsFlyer as the trusted leader in measurement.

What you’ll do:

- Act as the focal point for all inbound and outbound partner initiatives, with regular engagement from working level up to executives

- Manage and scale existing partnerships; identify new areas of growth and opportunity

- Evaluate, analyze, and prioritize inbound partner requests against the AppsFlyer roadmap, driving them to decision and delivery

- Build the case for AppsFlyer and customer needs outbound, influencing partners to adopt them and expand the mutual offering

- Write briefs and requirements, and align stakeholders on scope and external messaging

- Translate partner API, privacy, and attribution updates into product decisions, documentation, and customer communications

- Identify and mitigate partnership risks (technical, commercial, privacy, legal, competitive); own escalations and incidents end to end; define data-sharing guardrails that protect advertiser trust and neutrality

- Build and streamline partner processes (intake, prioritization, escalation paths, documentation, tracking), applying automation and AI tooling to save the team time

- Define and track KPIs for adoption, revenue impact, and integration quality, acting on gaps

- Partner with AppsFlyer GTM teams and partner marketing teams on joint GTM, launches, campaigns, and advertiser adoption; join advertiser calls to unblock adoption

- Train internal teams (regional PDMs, GTM) and partner sales, support, and marketing teams on integrations and best practices

- Use data analysis (SQL) to size impact and validate hypotheses; lead EBRs and business reviews that shape the strategic narrative for partners and leadership

- Lead global business reviews and product overviews for a wide range of stakeholders, including partner executives

- Present in internal and external sessions, sharing insights on AppsFlyer features and partner ecosystem trends

- Connect PMs, Product Marketing, Legal, CS, Support, and executives around partner opportunities, risks, and ongoing requirements

What you have:

- 6+ years in ad tech or a related industry, with proven success building business partnerships with measurable results, owning strategy and execution end to end

- Proven success in a role requiring technical understanding and direct interaction with Product teams; ability to connect business outcomes to product development

- In-depth knowledge of the ad tech ecosystem: advertisers, ad networks, agencies, technology platforms

- Experience with global enterprise companies and partner stakeholders at all levels, including executives

- Comfort with data analysis (SQL) to size impact, validate hypotheses, and back recommendations

- Experience organizing and breaking down strategic objectives into tactical, actionable milestones

- Ability to manage cross-functional and cross-time zone priorities in a global, collaborative environment

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to lead meetings and executive reviews

Bonus points:

- Experience as a Program Manager, Product Manager, or Consultant

- Experience working for or with Google or Meta

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly analytical FP&A Business Partner to support AppsFlyer budget owners.

We are looking for you, an out-of-the-box thinker who can turn data into actionable insights. Imagine the impact you can have by analyzing our business, forecasting, reporting financial results, implementing monitoring processes, and providing key insights.

To make that happen, you’ll bring strong analytical skills, experience in building financial models, and communication skills.

What you'll do:

- Build & maintain budgets, rolling forecasts, and ongoing tracking of actual vs. budget analysis

- Own end-to-end financial planning for assigned OPEX departments, including headcount and operating expenses

- Act as a business partner and advisor for business unit management

- Partner closely with senior leadership to support strategic decision-making

- Build strong partnerships with key stakeholders

- Develop and maintain financial and operational models and procedures

- Design, automate, and optimize flexible FP&A processes and systems to meet the needs of a dynamic and fast-growing business environment

What you have:

- 5+ years of experience in FP&A, financial planning, budgeting & control, or a similar finance business partnering role

- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

- Experience working with senior management for business units or departments

- Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving ability

- Comfortable taking ownership of projects and driving to a successful conclusion

- Experience using AI tools as part of FP&A workflows

- Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite an advantage) and financial planning systems (Pigment an advantage)

- Experience in high-tech companies- an advantage

- BA in Economics/Accounting

Bonus Points:

- Introduced by an AppsFlyer team member

Position number: 2841

As a global company operating from 25 offices across 19 countries, we reflect the human mosaic of the diverse and multicultural world in which we live. We ensure equal opportunities for all of our employees and promote the recruitment of diverse talents to our global teams without consideration of race, gender, culture, or sexual orientation. We value and encourage curiosity, diversity, and innovation from all our employees, customers, and partners.

“As a Customer Obsessed company, we must first be Employee Obsessed. We need to make sure that we provide the team with the tools and resources they need to go All-In.”  Oren Kaniel, CEO
